content: Hello! In #40117, I proved Measurable (fun (μ, v) ↦ gaussianReal μ v). @David Ledvinka suggests me a way to achieve a better proof involving proving such lemmas Measurable (fun (μ, v, x) ↦ gaussianPDFReal μ v x). This issue is that this new auxiliary lemma implies that docs#ProbabilityTheory.measurable_gaussianPDFReal can now be proven with fun_prop (same for docs#ProbabilityTheory.measurable_gaussianPDF). I face the following dilemma: as measurable_gaussianPDF is used is some proofs and cannot be directly replaced by fun_prop (see the proof of docs#ProbabilityTheory.integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul), I wonder if I should delete it anyway and adapt the proofs or keep it but in this case I would need nice names for the new auxiliary lemmas that generalizes the measurability statements. Does anyone knows what would be the best choice?
I think it's ok to keep the old lemmas, just no need to tag them with fun_prop. Regarding the names, I think you can use measurable_uncurry_gaussianPDFReal.
